The edge of one petal in the upper right seems to merge slightly into the background bokeh more abruptly than optical depth of field would typically allow, suggesting slight generation bleeding.

To analyze the subtle texture anomalies and waxy appearance noted in the initial scan for signs of AI smoothing.

Check if the yellow center's texture looks like distinct florets or just random noise. Verify if the petal overlaps have correct occlusion shadows.
